name: PS5LM Plus
description: Native PS5 homebrew app for running GGUF large language models locally on the console using llama.cpp and Vulkan GPU acceleration. Includes a TV dashboard, local model library, Hugging Face model downloads, automatic memory and context planning, persistent download queue, system monitoring, llama.cpp web chat and OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible APIs for devices on the local network.
author: abhi245y / Mert Cobanov
